Reference assignments: <Picture 1> is the opening composition, wardrobe and set. Start at this image.
Jerry: use <Video 1> for this character's face, mannerisms and identity, and <Audio 1> for their voice. Ignore the reference's wardrobe, setting, laughter and spoken words; follow the new script.
George: use <Video 2> for this character's face, mannerisms and identity, and <Audio 2> for their voice. Ignore the reference's wardrobe, setting, laughter and spoken words; follow the new script.
Kramer: use <Video 3> for this character's face, mannerisms and identity, and <Audio 3> for their voice. Ignore the reference's wardrobe, setting, laughter and spoken words; follow the new script.

1990s American multi-camera television sitcom. Use the composition and wardrobe of the supplied starting image, warm flat studio lighting, slightly soft broadcast-video appearance. Static or gently reframed camera; natural acting and deadpan comedy. Everyone treats their statements as serious. Maintain faces, clothes, voice identities and set geometry across shots. Only Kramer grooming and demeanor change at his return. No captions, graphics, dramatic lighting, extra characters, or cinematic camera movement. Generate clean dialogue without studio audience sounds; audience reactions are added during editing.

Set: Jerry Seinfeld apartment. Use each supplied starting image for exact camera angle, character placement, lighting and set geometry. Green-gray casement window and blinds; pale wood front door on screen left of the gray kitchen counter, refrigerator and cabinets behind the counter. Preserve this layout.

Cast and permanent speaker IDs:
Jerry: S1. Jerry Seinfeld: slim, short dark curly hair, red shirt as in the starting image. Clear, lightly nasal conversational voice, dry delivery.
George: S2. George Costanza: stocky, balding with dark side hair, round glasses, muted brown/olive overshirt as in the starting image. Mid-pitched nasal voice that tightens when agitated.
Kramer: S3. Cosmo Kramer: tall, lanky, high dark hair, mustard-brown long-sleeve shirt as in the starting image. Low, slightly gravelly voice. Same face and clothes throughout; posture and grooming change as specified.

Blocking: Interior medium three-shot beside the window: Jerry in red at left, George in brown/olive at center, Kramer in mustard at right. Jerry and George alone speak their four lines. George squints outside to screen left. Jerry is matter-of-fact. Kramer stays completely silent with lips closed throughout this entire clip, reacting only with his eyes. Exactly four utterances, no filler words.

Appearance state:  Starting image fixes wardrobe and staging. Source videos provide face identity and voice only. Never copy their clothes, old dialogue, diner setting or audience laughter.

Duration: 8.000 seconds, 24 fps. Timeline:

[0.00s–0.50s] Silent establishing/reaction beat. No speech.

[0.50s–0.92s] George alone says exactly: “Woah.”

[1.32s–2.98s] Jerry alone says exactly: “Look at his monitors.”

[3.38s–5.05s] George alone says exactly: “He only has one.”

[5.45s–6.28s] Jerry alone says exactly: “Bitcoin guy.”

After the last line, hold a silent reaction through 8.000s; no extra words.

Audio: natural conversational English, quiet room tone. Only the identified speaker talks; other mouths remain still. Keep each voice attached to its own character. Clean production dialogue only. No audience, laughter, laugh track, applause, narration, added dialogue, music, or overlapping speech. Leave the opening and ending reaction beats free of speech and vocal sounds for editing. Use small reaction pauses. No subtitles or on-screen text.
